verses.15:68: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِي فَلَا تَفۡضَحُونِ

meaning: The root فضح (f-ḍ-ḥ) primarily means to expose someone's faults or vices, disgracing them. It can also describe the moon or dawn outshining stars, making them disappear.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
